hooks.command: n=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && printf '{"systemMessage":"⚠ %s uncommitted file(s) — consider committing"}' "$n" || true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); b=$(basename "$f" 2>/dev/null); case "$b" in app.py|config.py|requirements.txt|api.py) [ README.md -ot "$f" ] && printf '{"systemMessage":"📝 %s changed — README.md documents this surface and is older. Check whether it needs updating."}' "$b" ;; esac; true
